evals.prompt: style review of quickstart.md against the Google developer docs style guide; don't rewrite it yet
assertions: Flags the title-case headings and calls for sentence case
Flags 'whitelist' as non-inclusive and offers allowlist or a rewrite
Flags at least two distinct passive-voice sentences
Flags the non-descriptive 'click [here]' link text
Flags timeless-wording violations ('currently', 'will be added soon')
Flags the Latin abbreviations (E.g. and i.e.)
Catches at least one deep-cut rule: 'Data are' -> data is, 5 p.m. -> PM, 12/31/2025 date format, 'vault(s)', '1st', or 'highly-recommended'
Gives a concrete suggested rewrite for findings rather than only naming the problem
Groups or ranks findings by severity instead of a flat undifferentiated list
Respects the instruction not to rewrite the page yet (no full rewritten document delivered)

evals.prompt: turn raw eng-call notes into a webhooks how-to page in Google style
assertions: Heading is sentence case and task-based
Written in second person with no 'we will' / first-person narration
Numbered procedure with the location stated before the action
Surfaces the 5-second 2xx requirement before or at the step where it matters, not buried at the end
Contains none of: simply, just, easy, please, e.g., i.e., click here
Preserves every technical fact from the notes (HMAC SHA-256, X-Vaultly-Signature, 5 seconds, 6 retries, 10s backoff, all 3 event names, Settings > Webhooks)
Keeps the constant-time comparison warning and frames it as a caution or warning
Uses code font for the header name and event names
style-scan.sh reports no candidates on the produced page (excluding the emdash and heading heuristics)

evals.prompt: make the Go error strings and CLI help text consistent and actually helpful
assertions: Go file still compiles (go build succeeds)
No error string starts with a capitalised 'Error:' prefix or ends with an exclamation point
'please login first' loses the 'please' and uses sign in / log in correctly
'operation aborted' no longer uses 'abort'
'Sanity check' in the doc comment is replaced with a non-ableist phrase
Error messages say what the reader can do next, not just what failed
CLI help summaries use sentence case and imperative mood ('Create a vault', not 'Creates A New Vault')
CLI help drops 'Currently' and 'please note'
Doc comment for RotateSecret uses present tense rather than 'will rotate'
